notes.title: Hint System & Visual Improvements | v1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

So far, we've had a lot of fun watching your playthroughs and received many useful pieces of feedback as well. One of the suggestions we often see is regarding improved in-game guidance. We want to try and provide clearer hints that you guys can use to keep the game flow as smooth and enjoyable as possible. So, we added a new feature where you can enable a hint system during the memory association process.

We also improved the button mash UI clarity during the [spoiler]calming down[/spoiler] sequence.

Undying Flower v1.2.0

🆕 New Features:
 Memory association hint system

🛠 Improvements:
 Button mash UI clarity
 Fixed weird white lines in main menu opening book scene
 Fixed Nala's legs occasionally disappearing during the first person view
 Improved certain character's eyes animation in one of the ending scenes

Let us know what you think about the new hint system!
Also feel free to let us know if you encounter any other issues. We have a pinned post in our game discussion page for bug reporting and troubleshooting page that you may want to check out. You can also report a bug through our Discord server.

notes.title: Steam Achievements and Community Items | v1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We've just added Steam Achievements to the game, so now you can track what you may be missing as you play. We've also added Steam Community items, including trading cards, badges, backgrounds, and emoticons. Hope you enjoy collecting and showing them off!

We also fixed a few issues and made some small improvements based on your feedback. Thanks for all the suggestions, and please keep them coming!


Undying Flower v1.1.0

🆕 New Features:

 Added Steam Achievements

 Added Steam Community items: trading cards, badges, backgrounds, and emoticons

🛠 Improvements:

 Adjusted Nala's walking speed

 Adjusted text timing in hospital corridor scene

 Fixed little Nala's head position when she is walking towards the white door

 Fixed position of the last text in grandpa & Nala walking scene

 Fixed blinking visuals in credits


Feel free to let us know if you encounter any issue. We have a pinned post in our game discussion page for bug reporting and troubleshooting page that you may want to check out. You can also report a bug through our Discord server.

notes.title: Bug Fixes | v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you so much to everyone who’s played, left a review, streamed the game, or told a friend. Your support means a lot to us. 💖

We've heard some of our players encountered issues during gameplay, and we've just pushed a small update to address some of the issues.

Undying Flower v1.0.1

🛠 Bug fixes:

 Prevented auto-save during the journal tutorial to fix uncontrollable player bug when user reload the save data from the main menu
 Disabled move between memory points during journal tutorial
 Fixed Nala stands on a wrong position when changing Memory Point at a certain moment
 Fixed Nala visibility & positioning that blocks a text when simulating memory manipulation
 Fixed a text bug in one of the diorama when simulating memory manipulation
 Fixed where certain cutscenes run improperly during the second playthrough
 Fixed Comet in Mummyland song from being repeated
 Fixed wrong dialogue in near ending (Nala dialogue shown as grandpa dialogue)
 Fixed a misspelling in the credits
 Fixed a minor font issue in Option's resolutions text
 Fixed where some tutorial texts turned black during the second playthrough

🛠 Quality Improvements:

 Improved good ending music quality
 Minor rendering optimization
 Improved reflection quality on high settings, and improved reflection performance on low settings

🛠 Known Issues:

 In a very low performance device, black screen can appear after interacting with a Memory Fragment. In this case, the game must be reloaded from the main menu.
 In a very rare instance the water reflection on certain scene flickered and emitted very bright light. To temporarily fix it, change the screen resolution to any other resolution. Once it's resolved, you can switch back to your original resolution.

Feel free to let us know if you encounter any issue. We have a pinned post in our game discussion page for bug reporting and troubleshooting page that you may want to check out. You can also report a bug through our Discord server.
